attention_diagnostics.attention_formula: causal_exp(QK^T / sqrt(d_k) + D) V, D_ti = (t - i) log alpha_ti, log alpha_ti = -exp(A_log) softplus(x_t w_query + x_i w_key + dt_bias) per layer/head, w_key initialized zero and the other gate parameters with Gated DeltaNet's initialization; x_t and x_i are the query and key tokens' activations after the block input RMSNorm, then per-head RMSNorm over value channels with a learned gain
attention_diagnostics.attention_score_formula: exp(gamma_h) * <g_Q * q / sqrt(mean(q^2) + eps), g_K * k / sqrt(mean(k^2) + eps)> / sqrt(d_K); independent Q/K channel gains per layer, shared across heads; gamma_h learned independently per layer/head, initially zero

forget_gate.formula: log alpha_ti = -exp(A_log) softplus(x_t w_query + x_i w_key + dt_bias)
forget_gate.sample_domain: all causal query-key pairs in the diagnostic sample, including diagonal
